visuals.heading: Weekly Structure That Survives a Real Job

items.text: A study plan only works if it can absorb a bad week without collapsing.
You have 18-24 months of expenses saved, separate from any exam or coaching cost.
Morning hours before your job starts are the only slot your employer cannot quietly eat into with a late meeting or an urgent ask.
Audio revision, flashcards, and re-reading condensed notes work well in transit or short breaks.
Leave is the single biggest lever a working aspirant has, and also the most commonly wasted one.
The lever most working aspirants underuse

blocks.heading: Burnout Does Not Usually Announce Itself

items.text: You are studying more hours but retaining less
This is the clearest early signal.
A timetable built for someone with 10 open hours a day will not survive contact with a job.
A plan with zero recovery time looks impressive on paper and collapses the first time work runs late or you get sick.
If you have never tracked how many focused hours you genuinely manage in a working week, you do not yet have the data to decide whether quitting would even help.
Before changing anything about your job, spend a couple of weeks simply tracking your real focused study hours against your job's actual demands.
Earlier financial freedom does not have to wait for exam results.

If you are weighing this decision against other exam options entirely, SSC vs bank exams: which to prepare for and government job vs private job India cover the earlier decisions this plan depends on.

blocks.heading: Period and Job Timing Around Your Exam
blocks.sourceSectionTitle: Notice period and job timing around your exam

rows: You plan to resign only after clearing the exam

Keep your current notice period visible on your calendar against your exam's typical result and joining timeline. A 60-90 day notice period can genuinely delay your joining date if you resign only after results are out, many services expect joining within a fixed window.
You are considering resigning before results, to focus on a final stage

Do this only if the runway math already works (see the quit-or-stay section above). Resigning on hope, without savings or a fallback plan, is the single most common regret pattern working aspirants describe after a cycle that does not go their way.
Your current employer has a probation or bond clause

Some private-sector offers, and almost all PSU or bank training programmes, include a minimum service bond with a buyback clause. Read this before you assume you can exit cleanly the moment a government result arrives.
You are already a government or PSU employee applying for a different service

Check your current service's rules on permission to apply for another government post while employed, several services require a No Objection Certificate before you can even sit certain competitive exams.

blocks.heading: Honest Odds: Working Vs Full-Time Prep
blocks.sourceSectionTitle: Honest odds: working vs full-time prep

rows: UPSC Civil Services, recent cycle selection ratio
Roughly 1,000 selections from over 5.7 lakh candidates who appeared, close to 0.1-0.17% overall.
Around 1.5 years to a first serious attempt for most full-time aspirants who start from a reasonable base.
Commonly 2-3 years, because weekly study volume runs lower and more of it happens on weekends.
SSC CGL / IBPS PO, while working
A focused working aspirant can realistically prepare in 6-12 months, since the syllabus and stages are shorter than UPSC.
Share of successful UPSC candidates who cleared on their first attempt
A small minority, most successful candidates needed multiple attempts, commonly 3-4 or more.

visuals.heading: Quit Your Job to Prepare Full-Time

blocks.heading: This Is Your First Serious Attempt

items.text: Your job genuinely allows 3-5 quality hours most weekdays, even if it takes negotiation to get there.
Your household depends on this income, or a job gap would be hard to explain to future employers if the exam does not work out.
You have not yet built a real routine, quitting before proving you can study consistently just removes the income cushion without fixing the discipline problem.
